messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: INC-2026XXXX - deploy-canary/us-west-2 - 504 gateway timeout spike detected (30% 5xx over 5m). Auto-pager routing to on-call.
mae: acked. I'm oncall and taking lead. Noted spike on canary after the model-embed-v12 rollout. Tagging runtime and platform.
sam: looking now — seeing kernel errors and KV cache miss rate climbing. Pulling recent deploy hash: sha1:a1b2c3d4. Logs show repeated 'quant kernel failed' messages on a subset of hosts.
mae: confirmed canary pods: 3/5 unhealthy. Healthcheck endpoints returning 502->504 on /v1/generate. Initiating rollback of canary to previous model-embed-v11.
deploy-bot: Rollback started for deployment 'model-embed' in namespace 'inference' -> rolling back to revision 11. Command executed: kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/model-embed --to-revision=11
alyssa: adding impact note: p95 latency up to 5.2s; error rate ~15% for search product traffic hitting canary. Flagging customer impact (partial outage).
nate: customer support queue spike — open tickets from Acme and BetaCorp. Messaging them with a brief notice.
mae: short mitigation plan: 1) rollback (in progress), 2) divert 50% canary traffic to eu-west dedicated pool, 3) capture core dumps and driver logs, 4) notify CS. Running traffic diversion now.
sam: confirmed kernel logs show driver-version mismatch on quantized path for a subset of GPU types, reproducing locally on new quant build. Creating bug: BUG-1245. Collecting core dumps -> s3://redwood-logs/canary/3117773333/kernel-dumps.tar.gz
jules: escalated to platform team for potential rollforward remediation if rollback doesn't stabilize. Opening PD escalation to platform. INC link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC-2026XXXX
support-bot: PagerDuty update: INC-2026XXXX acknowledged by mae at 2026-03-14T22:00:12Z. Current status: investigating.
mae: progress update: rollback in flight, 1) rolling undo started, 2) divert 50% traffic to eu-west (trafficctl set-split executed). If rollback finishes and 5xx < 1% for 10m we close; otherwise escalate rollforward.
nate: sent templated customer notice to Acme/BetaCorp: "We detected elevated error rates on inference requests; we are rolling back the canary release and expect reduced errors within 10–15 minutes. We'll update in 30 minutes." :email: 
sam: partial rollback logs show pods being replaced; on rolled-back pods 5xxs drop immediately. Continuing to gather driver and libcudnn versions for forensics.
alyssa: reducing severity P1 -> P2 (partial degradation) as mitigation actions in progress and customer notices sent. Marking the incident as 'active - mitigations applied'. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Rollback progress: 3/5 replicas rolled back successfully; no new 5xx on those pods for 4m. ETA remaining ~6m.
mae: preparing handoff plan for night shift at 00:00Z: jules will take over monitoring and coordinate with platform if rollforward is required. If rollback completes and metrics stable, we'll close and write a postmortem.
jules: acked handoff and will monitor metrics and PD. I'll open a follow-up ticket for postmortem and remediation timeline.
incident-bot: Incident update posted to PD: INC-2026XXXX — status: monitoring; last update at 3117774030.
mae: rollback completed at 22:13Z. p95 latency back to ~300ms, error rate down to 0.8%. Closing actions: 1) Collect final artifacts (sam), 2) Draft postmortem (jules + mae), 3) Remediation: pin quant kernel build, add additional canary vetting for driver mismatches.
jules: filing postmortem stub: doc-internal/pm/INC-2026XXXX.md. Will include timeline, root cause, and follow-ups (driver verification in CI, stronger canary health checks).
mae: thanks all — solid coordination. :clap: Closing thread but will update postmortem link once ready.
